title: Binary Tree Maximum Width
problemStatement: Given the root of a binary tree, compute the maximum width among all levels. The width of a level is defined as the number of positions between the leftmost and rightmost non-null nodes, including any missing nodes in between. Return the maximum width.
input: The root of a binary tree.
output: A single integer representing the maximum width.
constraints: Number of nodes is in the range [1, 3000]
